node.title: XR minimum rank-two trades are face syzygies or near-tangent cores
node.statement: In an arbitrary-rank uniform XR split pencil, every rank-two trade on its minimum active union |X|=a+2 has facet supports X\{x_i}. The order-a facet divided differences of U and q are affine in x_i. Distinct slopes force an exact dichotomy: either all selected denominators are nonzero and the relation space is the dimension-(t-3) Plucker kernel of (1;x_i;gamma_i;x_i gamma_i), or both facet forms vanish identically and the received directions share a k+2 agreement core. A partially singular pattern is impossible. After quotienting regular face syzygies, rank-two residue has union at least a+3 or the explicit near-tangent defect h-2.
